title: Welcome and Table of Contents
summary: What SS1 Mathematics First Term covers, how to study each unit, and a map of every unit by week.

p: Mathematics is the language of science, business, technology and daily life. It trains your mind to think clearly and to solve problems step by step. In SS1 First Term you will meet new ideas that you will use up to SS3 and in WAEC, NECO and JAMB: other number bases, modular arithmetic, indices, logarithms, formulas and variation, quadratic equations and their graphs, and logical reasoning.
These notes follow the Nigerian scheme of work for SS1 First Term, week by week. The language is kept simple and every topic has worked examples that you can follow line by line.

Read the notes slowly. Then cover the worked example, try it yourself and compare. Write the key formulas in your notebook. At the end of every unit do the activity and the practice questions. The practice questions do not count towards a mark; they help you see whether you understood. Answer them all correctly to complete the unit.
You will need a pencil, a ruler, graph paper (for some topics) and a scientific calculator. Always show your working and write the answer with its units where there are units.

p: Practise a little every day instead of a lot once a week. When you make a mistake, find out why, and fix the idea, not only the answer. Check your answers by substituting back or by using a different method. Ask for help early. Try past WAEC and NECO questions after each topic.
